title: Maria asks to borrow more; the loan officer declines
description: A full flow with both agents. Maria changed jobs in March and got a raise last month; the application agent should complete her application after her new pay stub arrives. The bank then sends her the offer she asked for ($15,000 over 48 months). A day later she asks to borrow $20,000 instead. The offer agent cannot decide this: it should ask a loan officer and tell her a loan officer will decide, without promising anything. The officer declines a day later; the offer agent should tell her that her request was declined and the $15,000 offer still stands. Two days after that she signs the $15,000 offer.
